A new awesome map created by Luminous has been included in the collection of official maps. As usual, it keeps a set of unique items.

- Game no longer crashes when menus or multiplayer menu are enabled when you die.

- Pressing the shortcut key for the character page twice no longer bugs the menu

- Toy hammer could not be recovered when dropped on the hero's home or the bank. Now it can't be dropped there.

- "Vampire Hand" picture was wrong (it had an arrow)

- The advanced editor no longer crashes when pressing '4' on the water section.

- Horgan's Axe no longers disappears when you pick it up in the "Bax Simbel" official multiplayer map.

- Sometimes you could not attack an invisible creature while seeing invisible.

And a change has been done on an item that was too OP for being level 14:

- "Ranged Anger" was too over for being a level 14 bow. dam reduced from 260 to 150, and changed "acid" by "poison".


Have fun,
fran

notes.title: Version 1.51.00: 20+, balancing and cheaters
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Version 1.51.00 of Unepic is finally out.
This patch contains these 3 features:

[b]1.- Level 20+[/b]
In multiplayer, players wil be capable to go beyond level 20, being 20+1, 20+2, 20+3...
Each extra level will grant:
[list]
[*] +5% damage in all weapons
[*] +10% damage in all spells
[*] + 25 HP max.
[/list]


[b]2.- Balancing[/b]
In order to balance the game (swords for instance were too OP) and improve it, we did the following changes:

ITEMS:
[list]
[*] Healing idol. Heal dmg reduced to 100%. Regeneration reduced to 30.
[*] Executor armor. Melee and range protection increased to 400. Mace and axe atk speed reduced to 30%
[*] Spike's eviscreator. Lvl 14->16. Dmg 275->225. Sword atk speed 40%->30%
[*] Axe of the crypt keeper. Damage 700->800
[*] Storm. Dmg 300->400
[*] Spear of Gendurion. Atack speed 10%->20%. Crit change 10%->5%  Dmg 300->425
[*] Stiven's rib. Dmg 350->400
[*] Umbra's leather armor of evasion. Lvl 14->16. Melee and ranged protection 125->100
[*] Armor of dark archer. Melee and ranged prot 125->175. Extra dmg with bows 100->150. Atk speed with bows 10%->20%
[*] Armor of Gendurion. Level needed 14->16
[*] Range Deathwearer. Bow crit change 5%->15%
[*] Blessed thornmail of Cecil. Max hp 400->500. Damage returned from melee 150%->200%
[*] Blessed platemail of Luxor. Regeneraion 11->10. Lvl needed 7->14.  Prot against melee 85->100, prot range 95->100
[*] Pieces of demonic armor. Dmg with arcane 75%->100%. Crit change with arcane 15%->5%
[*] Armor of devoted paladin. Protection against melee range and arcane 200->250. Max health 300->250
[*] Drill. Dmg 200->250. Crit change with bows 10%->15%
[*] Blessed armor of Raak. Melee and ranged prot 360->500
[*] Golem armor. General speed -20% -> -15%
[*] Fracture. Dmg 300->400. Added mace crit chance(+10%) and mace atk speed(+10%)
[*] Chap. Dmg 350->500. Added axe crit chance(+25%)
[*] Peignoir of great Occultist. Prot against arcane 100->400. Extra skeletons 1->4
[*] Rings of weapon mastery. Dmg 25->50(every ring)
[*] Rings of magic mastery. Crit chance 5%->10%(every ring)
[*] Rings of eternity. Dmg 5%->20%(every ring)
[*] Crystal of archmage. Extra dmg 10%->25%
[*] Holy cross. Extra dmg with light 10%->25%. Crit chance 5%->10%
[*] Latern of miracle healing. Extra healing speed (15)is removed. Added heal crit chance(+10%)
[*] Ashes DMG 310->375, att speed swords 10%->20%
[/list]

MULTIPLAYER

[list]
[*] Vendors in Home now sell robes and staves.
[/list]

SPELLS

[list]
[*] Throwing knive. Dmg dealt on the back increased by 50%. Extra crit chance of this knife 10%->20%
[*] Bomb. Damage is increased to 300%
[*] Wind cut. KP cost 1->2. Doesn't deal double dmg to the first enemy. Piercing dmg decreases with more enemies you hit.
[*] Ghost axe. KP cost 2->1.
[*] Wrath. KP cost 2->1.
[*] Move out. Extra speed given is increased by 50%. KP cost 2->1.
[*] Split shot. KP cost 2->1. 
[/list]




[b]3.- Anticheat[/b]

Unfortunately the number of complains due to cheaters have grown up recently. They tend to alter characters of other players, annoy them and even ruin their characters.
To prevent this, the following actions were taken:
[list]
[*] Blacklist: A blacklist of cheaters. Those in the black list will be rejected by everyone else when joining a game or session.

[*] Cheat detection: normal players will be informed if their characters have been altered somehow.

[*] Altered character detection: When entering in the "Multiplayer" section, the game scans all characters and, if any of them had illegal features, they will be informed to the player.
[/list]
So, if you are aware that someone is cheating somehow, feel free to report it and this cheater will be included in the blacklist.



That's all for now.
Thanks for playing Unepic!

notes.title: v 1.50.02
notes.notes:
Hello!

First patch after leaving Early Access is here.
It's just a bunch of bugs fixed:

 - fixed: Bonus speed for weapons have been fixed (the calculation was wrong).
- fixed: "Lifesteal" weapons only absorbs HP of monsters when killed with the weapon, not magic.
- fixed (MP): Extra Skill Points can't be set any longer in laggy servers.
- fixed: mines and web traps created by player no longer counts as an enemy for appearing ladders/doors/platforms
- fixed: Battle Cry and Move Out were not applied to allies.
- fixed (MP): "destroy barrels" scroll did not work in all types of barrels.
- fixed (EDITOR): creatures set to "big" or "small" were not saved.
- fixed (MP): Items no longer appear duplicated in non-cooperative mp dungeons.
- fixed (EDITOR): Weapon choice for creatures is now working ok.
- fixed (EDITOR): Heal spells given to mobs were not applied in their allies.
- fixed: "spawn: max number on screen" not working when mob was ally.
- fixed: "Robes skill" could not be increased when "Armor Skill" was set to the maximum.
- fixed: "cheating scrolls" in PVP are working again.
- changed (MP): Blessed armor of Raak reduced slowness from 50 to 40.
- changed: Increased attack resist from 1 to 2 in concentration robes level 11.
- changed: Increased divine favours from 1 to 2 in White robes level 11.
- changed: extra damage given by rings x2.

notes.title: PowerPlay gives 6/10 ruining the MetaScore.
notes.notes:
Hello guys,

PowerPlay is giving a 6 over 10 to Unepic. The MetaScore of Unepic is very lowered due to that note because there are only 5 notes: 80,75,70 and 70.

The final note passes from 73,5 to 68 :-(

This is the review:
http://www.pcpowerplay.com.au/2012/08/review-unepic/

They are complaining about:
- side-quests: they breaks up the exploration.
- combat: not engaging.
- automatic saving: does not help.
- player dies a lot.
- inventory: management is a nightmare
- humor: well, humour is very subjective. A lot of people hates Jim Carrey's humor.

All comments are refered to the "demo" zone: the traps and fecundation quests, the "orcs" (goblins of the mine), so that makes me suspect that the person who did the review just played a few, and did not even use any of the magic schools, or played all other side-quests of the game, or challenges, or multiplayer, etc.

Sumarising, I'm afraid that the wrong person voted the game, and his score is so important that is decreasing the score of Unepic that hundred of thousands of people are seeing in the Steam shop 5 points down (from 7,3 to 6,8).

I am going to write them asking to revise the review, or be it rewritten by someone who played further. Also will ask what side-quests they don't like, why inventory is a nightmare, tell them that there will be a "sort inventory" option in next patch, that there is a "salvation ring" available that tells you when the game is autosaved, and that there are tones of spells to have fun with.

The more comments disagreeing the review, the more strength to make them change their mind. So, if you are playing Unepic and you think that the note and the review is unfair, please leave a comment telling what you disagree:

http://www.pcpowerplay.com.au/2012/08/review-unepic/

thanks a lot!

pd: something curious: if you swap cyphers of metascore 6.8, you will obtain 8.6 that is the score of users.

notes.title: LAG check
notes.notes:
Hello,

Seeing that LAG is an important problem, I am working in a new way of communication to prevent big lags.
It is not yet implemented but we can see how much lag it will produce and, therefore, see if it worths or not.

While playing, in the TOP-LEFT corner there will be 2 lag numbers (instead of 1).
TOP - It is the current lag with the current system.
BOTTOM - it is the lag with the new system. This one should be equal or smaller than the current one.

If you have problems of lag with your friends, please test it, examine both lag figures, compare them and explain here what do you see. Is the second lag constant?

Have in mind that only Clients can see their lag.

I keep waiting your reports.
fran

notes.title: No P2W, no real money
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Looks like there is missinformation about Unepic and spending extra real money. Let's clarify it:
First of all, unepic is NOT and has never been a P2W (Pay to Win) game. This is totally false.

In the Steam version it is not possible to spend real money. The only that costs real money is the game itself.

All these hearsays about real money came because there is an option in the official web of unepic to purchase credits using real money. As usual, talking is easier than investigating or asking.

In non-steam versions, when someone completes a challenge in the game (there are 15 hidden challenges), you earn "unepic credits" that can be exchanged by special items. These special items are just to have fun and have special stats, but never needed to finish the game, like the "Austin Power's English suit", a "Stormtrooper plastic armor", the Enterprise pet, a ring that tells you when the game has been saved, and a lot more.

Like other extra contents like the multiplayer mode, HD support, dubbings, steamKeys and much others, this feature was done as a gift to people, asking no extra charge.

After this feature was released, a few people asked if they could obtain those credits using real money instead of completing the challenges within the game, so I included this option in the web.

In the future I will implement these "Unepic credits" earned by doing challenges that are already available, and a vendor to get extra items.

Concerning using real money in Steam in the future, if I do it, it will be always to obtain funny things and never needed to play the game normally.

notes.title: Read this if you play Multiplayer
notes.notes:
This is a list of things you might need to know about multiplayer before playing it. Please, open a new post to give your opinion about them.

[b]1.- There is no tutorial: play single player first.[/b]
People that tested multiplayer already played the single player mode, so we did not think about new players that wanted to play multplayer directly. While this is fixed, I suggest you play single player, at least the first level, to know how to play.

[b]2.- Use INS (insert) key to activate CHAT.[/b]
You can chat with people within the game using the INS key (can be changed in the main menu in OPTIONS > CONTROLS > chat)

[b]3.- Items can be repaired.[/b]
Repair them in the town (Hero's home, going right). You need the "key of the mine" to enter the houses, therefore, to kill boss #2.

[b]4.- broken items[/b]
After level 5, when you die, your equipped items are broken 5%.

[b]5.- Hidden secrets[/b]
There are hidden secrets behind false walls that can be broken if you hit them. In level 1, for instance, there are 3 hidden savepoints.

[b]6.- Balancing[/b]
Multiplayer is a mode that is in development. It is not finished and needs balancing and polishing. Your written opinions, seeing videos and LIVE streaming of players will help me calibrate the game to be as nice as possible.

[b]7.- Be polite[/b]
If you find something too hard, or you don't like how it is made, do not swear, blame and troll in the meeting point. First of all relax, then make a quick look in case someone thought the same thing and already opened a post, and then write what you don't like and how it could be fixed or improved. Something like "Hello, In level 1 there are very few savepoints and this forced me to walk a lot. I think that there should be at least 3 or 4 more".

[b]8.- Sharing items[/b]
You can not share items that have been aquired in another session.
Only items that drop in the current game can be shared.
This is not comfortable but for now it is the best option to avoid massive replication of items (cheating).

[b]9.- Saving the game[/b]
The game is only saved in cooperative mode. To save it, select "menu > session > save and exit". The game is not autosaved.
Use only "force quit" when the game is stuck.

[b]10.- PVP not saving[/b]
The game is not saved in PvP mode. So it doesn't matter how many things you spend/lose/break because nothing is saved.

[b]11.- Recover a session[/b]
If the connection is lost between the host and client, or if the client crashes, the character of the client will not be lost. It will remain in the host so, if the client connects again, he will continue in the same point with the same XP and items.
The only critical problem is when the host crashes.

[b]12.- Dialogs[/b]
Dialogs tell clues about what you will find. It is good to read them, at least the first time you play the level.

[b]13.- Number of players[/b]
The maximum number of players is 3 for cooperative mode, and 8 for PVP.

[b]14.- The Halo[/b]
If you are stuck, use the Halo to get back to the last save point (coffin).

notes.title: Now Available - UnEpic
notes.notes:
UnEpic is Now Available on Steam

UnEpic is the tale of Daniel, an ordinary gamer who finds himself in the middle of an amazing RPG adventure.

While the stage seems set for a typical role-playing adventure, Daniel will soon discover that everything is not what it seems...

The single player mode of UnEpic is 100% finished: 20 hours of adventures including achievements and cloud saving ready to be played. The game's multiplayer mode remains in Early Access and includes 7 different dungeons and 3 different gameplay modes.
